games.name: Pure 21.5 Spanish Blackjack
games.card_text: Tens out of the deck. Split up to three times, double more than once, and 21 always wins.
games.description: Played much like standard blackjack: beat the dealer's total without going over 21. The tens are taken out of the decks, but the picture cards stay in.

games.card_text: Four tables of Omaha and spread-limit Texas Hold'em, plus weekly tournaments.
games.description: Omaha and spread-limit Texas Hold'em cash games on four tables, plus weekly No-Limit Hold'em tournaments. Games change night to night, so call to hear what's playing.

games.name: Baccarat
games.card_text: Back the Player, the Banker or a tie. The hand closest to nine wins.
games.description: One of the most popular games anywhere. Back the Player, the Banker or a tie, and the hand closest to nine wins.

games.name: Ultimate Texas Hold'em
games.card_text: Heads-up against the dealer, with a Bad Beat bonus that pays win or lose.
games.description: Play heads-up against the dealer's hand. The Bad Beat bonus pays when the dealer has three of a kind or better, whether you win or lose the hand.
